title: Stored Grain Advance Rate for Members Financing Grain Storage with the Association — Operating Lines of Credit
content:
On an Operating Lines of Credit borrowing base certificate, the advance rate on unpriced stored grain turns on whether the member holds a Grain Storage & Handling Loan — one of the association's Equipment & Vehicle Loans — and on that loan's pledged collateral value.

## Rule

Unpriced stored grain is lent against at:

- **the product's advance rate on unpriced stored grain plus 5 points** when the member holds a Grain Storage & Handling Loan in active status whose pledged collateral value is at least USD 250,000 (250000);
- **the product's advance rate on unpriced stored grain plus 2.5 points** when the member holds a Grain Storage & Handling Loan in active status whose pledged collateral value is below USD 250,000;
- **the product's advance rate on unpriced stored grain** when the member holds no Grain Storage & Handling Loan in active status.

The loan's status and pledged collateral value are read from the member's Equipment & Vehicle Loans records.

## Rates by product (percent of market value)

| Product | Product rate | Grain Storage & Handling Loan active, collateral USD 250,000 or more | Active, collateral below USD 250,000 | No such loan in active status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 75 | 80 | 77.5 | 75 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 80 | 85 | 82.5 | 80 |
| StartRight Operating Line, ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line | 0 | 5 | 2.5 | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Agribusiness Revolving Line member)

| Grain Storage & Handling Loan held | Pledged collateral value | Rate on unpriced stored grain |
|---|---|---|
| Active | USD 250,000 | 85% |
| Active | USD 249,999 | 82.5% |
| Paid off, none active | — | 80% |
| An active Irrigation System Loan only | — | 80% — not a Grain Storage & Handling Loan |
